title: Generating function of the Krawtchouk polynomials
statement:
Let $n$ and $x$ be natural numbers with $x \le n$, and let $K_j^{(n)}(x)$ denote the binary Krawtchouk polynomial. Then for every real $z$,
\[
  \sum_{j=0}^{n} K_j^{(n)}(x)\, z^{j} \;=\; (1-z)^{x}\,(1+z)^{\,n-x}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: z is an arbitrary real number
sum ranges over j = 0 to n
